card.name: Linking words between combined drugs
card.fires_on: Small joining words or symbols (with, +, /, and, without) placed right after a drug name and before a partner drug such as ribavirin, interferon or velpatasvir, mostly in hepatitis C regimen text. It also fires weakly on a few ordinary linking words in general web text.

modes.label: Drug combination joiners
modes.description: A joining word or symbol after one antiviral drug name, just before the next drug in the regimen.

modes.label: Plain linking words in web text
modes.description: Ordinary articles or conjunctions in general prose, where a noun phrase is about to continue.
modes.example: It is half the diameter of Earth and has<< the>> same amount of dry land.

card.writes: It suppresses tokens like 'promot' and 'oppon' and promotes casual nouns, so it gives no clear drug-related output effect.
card.plain: It notices the small word that links one drug to the next drug in a combination regimen.
